content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Nagpur
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur is located at Plot no. 2, Sector-20, MIHAN, Nagpur – 441108. These posts are in the ICMR-funded multicentre trial "SMRITI: Stratified Multicentre RCT of Intravenous vs Traditional Inhalational Anaesthesia – A Biomarker-Stratified Multicentre RCT Evaluating Propofol TIVA vs Isoflurane for Postoperative Delirium Prevention in Geriatric Surgery". The Principal Investigator is Dr Omshubham Gangadhar Asai, Associate Professor, Department of Anaesthesiology and Critical Care, AIIMS Nagpur.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists two posts with one vacancy each, a total of 2 posts. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential: Three-year General Nursing and Midwifery course from a recognized institution. Desirable: Valid registration with the applicable State Nursing Council. Experience in perioperative nursing, critical care, geriatric nursing or clinical research. Familiarity with delirium assessment, cognitive screening, patient follow-up and clinical documentation. Good communication skills in Hindi, Marathi and English. Working knowledge of computers, spreadsheets and electronic data entry. Good Clinical Practice training or willingness to complete protocol-specific training before undertaking study duties. Essential: Three-year graduate degree in a relevant subject or field with three years of relevant post-qualification experience, OR a postgraduate degree in a relevant subject or field. For Engineering, Information Technology or Computer Science, a four-year graduate degree is eligible where relevant to the assigned project functions. All qualifications must be from a recognized university or institution. Relevant subjects: Medical Laboratory Technology, Medical Laboratory Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Life Sciences or Biomedical Sciences. Engineering / IT / Computer Science qualifications must be relevant to laboratory data systems or sample tracking. Desirable qualifications and skills: Hands-on experience in blood sample processing, serum or plasma separation, aliquoting, ELISA, pipetting, cold-chain management and sample inventory. Familiarity with laboratory quality control, biosafety, laboratory records and computer-based data entry. The notice states that desirable criteria are preferences and do not replace or add mandatory experience to an otherwise eligible qualification route. The notice gives the age limit as 30 years for each post. It does not print a cut-off date for counting age. Age relaxation, where applicable, will be as per prevailing ICMR and institute rules. Qualifications and relevant subject equivalence shall be governed by the applicable ICMR guidelines. Candidates with higher qualifications must also meet the prescribed essential eligibility criteria. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts pay ₹24000 per month (₹20000 + 20% HRA). The stated remuneration includes HRA at the budgeted rate; other allowances, if any, will be governed by the sanction and applicable rules. This is a fixed-duration, purely temporary post under an ICMR-funded project. It is not a regular post of ICMR or AIIMS Nagpur and confers no claim to permanent employment. The initial tenure is nine months in Year 1. Renewal is subject to project requirements, fund availability, performance assessment and institutional approval. The engagement will end automatically upon expiry of its approved term unless renewed. Leave, notice, termination and other service conditions will follow the applicable ICMR guidelines and institute orders.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Screen potential participants and support recruitment, participant information and consent procedures under investigator supervision and documented delegation. Conduct protocol-specified postoperative delirium assessments using CAM or CAM ICU and delirium severity assessments using CAM S, after completing training and competency assessment. Perform scheduled cognitive, recovery and pain assessments, and coordinate participant follow-up. Maintain blinding to treatment allocation and follow the study procedures restricting access to intraoperative allocation information. Maintain accurate case report forms, assessment records, follow-up trackers and source documentation. Coordinate protocol-specified sample collection with the clinical and laboratory teams. Promptly report clinical concerns, adverse events and protocol deviations to the investigator. Undertake related project duties assigned by the Principal Investigator. Clinical diagnosis and treatment decisions remain the responsibility of the treating investigators. Process and aliquot study samples according to SOPs. Maintain sample identification, inventory, temperature and cold-chain records. Assist with ELISA assays and laboratory quality control under supervision. Prepare reagents and maintain equipment logs. Coordinate sample receipt and shipment. Enter laboratory data and assist with consumable stock records. Blood collection, if assigned, requires appropriate training and institutional authorization. The terms and conditions add that the appointee will carry out duties assigned by the PI, including multicentre coordination, trial documentation, data quality oversight and biomarker workflow support.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened for eligibility, and shortlisted candidates will be notified through the AIIMS Nagpur website and/or email. Selection will be through a personal interview at AIIMS Nagpur. If more than 15 applications are received for a post, a written test may be conducted to shortlist candidates for interview. Date of interview: 21 November 2026 Reporting time: 8.00 AM Venue: Department of Anaesthesiology, 1st Floor IPD OT Complex, AIIMS Nagpur Candidates must produce original documents for verification. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 for the SMRITI project?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: one Project Nurse-II and one Project Technical Support-III.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted before 17:00 hr on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Nurse-II?
faq.answer: A three-year General Nursing and Midwifery course from a recognized institution is essential; State Nursing Council registration and clinical research experience are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: A three-year graduate degree in a relevant subject with three years of relevant post-qualification experience, OR a postgraduate degree in a relevant subject; a four-year degree in Engineering, IT or Computer Science is eligible where relevant to the project functions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30 years for both posts, with relaxation, where applicable, as per prevailing ICMR and institute rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Each post pays ₹24000 per month (₹20000 + 20% HRA).

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of ₹24000?
faq.answer: No, the stated remuneration of ₹24000 already includes HRA at the budgeted rate; other allowances, if any, will be governed by the sanction and applicable rules.

faq.question: Q8. How to apply for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply through the online application link for your post and upload the CV in the Annexure format with proof of date of birth, qualifications and experience; applications by email or post will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applications are screened, and selection is through a personal interview at AIIMS Nagpur on 21 November 2026; if more than 15 applications are received for a post, a written test may be conducted for shortlisting.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a fixed-duration, purely temporary project post with an initial tenure of nine months in Year 1, and it confers no claim to permanent employment at ICMR or AIIMS Nagpur.
